# Karadigm

Karadigm is a nearly monochromatic, minimalist theme with clean typography and subtle colored left borders on callouts. Style Settings offers three accent presets or a custom color, and the theme ships a unified set of 24 task checkboxes together with five circular progress indicators.

![Karadigm screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukokaravan-cloud/karadigm/HEAD/screenshot.png)
